# UC-364 — Define Product Variants Within Dimension and SKU Limits

## Header Info
- **Use Case ID:** UC-364
- **Title:** Define Product Variants Within Dimension and SKU Limits
- **Actor:** Vendor (ACT-02) — Editor/Manager/Owner staff
- **Trigger:** The vendor builds or edits the variant matrix of a listing draft
- **Priority:** P1
- **Goal:** Persist a variant set that respects the dimension, combination and SKU-uniqueness limits so the product can be published and stocked per variant.
- **Preconditions:** Own store scope (BR-VND-07); product row exists (DRAFT or ACTIVE); prices on the draft already pass BR-CAT-04.

## Main Scenario
1. Vendor opens the variant builder → client `GET /store/products/{id}` returns existing variants (API-CAT-007).
2. Vendor defines dimensions, combinations and SKUs → client `POST /store/products` or `PUT /store/products/{id}` (API-CAT-006, API-CAT-008).
3. Server validates ≤5 dimensions, ≤50 combinations and SKU uniqueness within the store (BR-CAT-02).
4. On success the variant rows persist as `{ sku, options, priceDelta, stock }` and are returned on the product detail (API-CAT-004).
5. Each variant SKU then appears as its own row in the inventory table (UC-365) with its own stock counters.

## Alternative Scenarios
- **A1 — Duplicate SKU in the same store:** rejected with 409 `DUPLICATE_RESOURCE`; vendor renames the SKU and retries (BR-CAT-02).
- **A2 — Same SKU in another store:** allowed — uniqueness is scoped per store, so a shared SKU across vendors never collides (BR-CAT-02).
- **A3 — Editing an ACTIVE product:** `PUT` re-validates the same limits on save, so an oversized matrix can never replace a live one (API-CAT-008).

## Exception Scenarios
- **E1 — Over the limit:** 6 dimensions or 51 combinations → 422 `VARIANT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`; no variant rows written (BR-CAT-02).
- **E2 — SKU collision:** a SKU already used in this store → 409 `DUPLICATE_RESOURCE`; the whole matrix is rejected atomically.
- **E3 — Foreign or unknown product:** → 404 `NOT_FOUND`; nothing evaluated (BR-VND-07).
- **E4 — Variant prices wrong alongside the matrix:** `PRICE_INVALID` returned in the same save; nothing persisted (BR-CAT-04).

## Postconditions
- Success: the full variant set is stored with store-unique SKUs and per-variant stock visible in inventory.
- Failure: no variant rows are written — the matrix commits as a unit or not at all.

## Business Rules Applied
- BR-CAT-02, BR-CAT-04, BR-CAT-07, BR-VND-07

## Related Requirements
- FR-004 (Product Catalog Management)

## Permissions / Data / External Dependencies
- **Permissions:** Editor/Manager/Owner on the own store only; authorization server-side (SEC-REQ-004).
- **Data involved:** product variant rows (sku, options, priceDelta, stock), per-SKU inventory rows.
- **External dependencies:** none — validation and persistence are in the catalog module; search index job follows later (BR-PLT-01).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC-UC364-01:** Given 6 dimensions, when the matrix is saved, then `VARIANT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` is returned and no variants are stored (BR-CAT-02).
- **AC-UC364-02:** Given 51 combinations, when saved, then `VARIANT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` is returned (BR-CAT-02).
- **AC-UC364-03:** Given a SKU already used in the same store, when saved, then `DUPLICATE_RESOURCE` is returned (BR-CAT-02).
- **AC-UC364-04:** Given the same SKU used by a different store, when saved, then it is accepted because uniqueness is per store.
